build_DIIHead: build a DIIHead instance with custom num_classes, num_heads, and feedforward_channels for Sparse R-CNN
run_DIIHead_forward: run the DIIHead forward pass with roi_feat and proposal_feat tensors to get cls_scores and bbox_preds
test_DIIHead_loss_and_target: test the DIIHead loss_and_target method with cls_score, bbox_pred, and sampling_results to compute losses
review_DIIHead_init_weights: review the DIIHead init_weights method to understand Xavier initialization and bias initialization for classification head
summarize_DIIHead_get_targets: summarize the DIIHead get_targets method that calculates ground truth labels and bbox targets from sampling results
